description: Apply a list of raw Google Sheets API batchUpdate request objects (rename/add tabs, cell number formats, column widths, frozen rows, etc.) to a spreadsheet. Runs as a background job: dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the replies arrive via a follow-up message once it completes. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Apply raw Google Sheets API batchUpdate requests to an existing spreadsheet as a background job: rename, add, or delete tabs; set number formats; resize columns; freeze rows; style headers. Dispatch returns a job_id for tracking; completion delivers the raw batchUpdate replies. The low-level surface for spreadsheet structure and formatting.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the spreadsheet batch update; completion will be delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job to apply structural or formatting edit requests to a Google Sheets spreadsheet.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id, requests is empty/not a list of dicts, a request object is malformed per the Sheets API (a common cause: a sheetId that does not exist in this spreadsheet), or missing session_id/flow_id context. gsuite.not_found: the spreadsheet id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.api_error: AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply a non-empty list of valid Sheets API request objects; the first tab of a new spreadsheet has sheetId 0, and added tabs report their sheetId in the addSheet reply. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account. gsuite.api_error: retry once platform startup has completed.
